# ADR-NNN: Short title

One page at most. File name `NNNN-short-title.md`; add a row to the [index](../adr/README.md).

- **Status:** Proposed | Accepted | Superseded by ADR-NNN
- **Date:** YYYY-MM-DD

## Context

What forces the decision, in a few lines. Link the principles and ADRs it builds on.

## Decision

The choice, as short bullets.

## Consequences

What becomes easier or harder, and what follows from it.

## Options considered

Each rejected option with the reason in one line.

**Revisit if** the condition that would reopen this decision.
